text:
Grace Lin: Heads-up from support: during the canary some teams reported the per-model cost heatmap showing near-zero for hot routes. That looks wrong.
Omar Hussein: Which view exactly? heatmap on Cost > By Model or the route-level table?
Grace Lin: Heatmap at project-level. It collapses to zero when router routes traffic to the prefetch-variant and we credit the prefetch. Users see a blank tile.
Felix Hart: We intentionally set prefetch_replay to zero out unit_cost in econ-ingest to avoid double counting prefetch reuse. But the UI needs to surface amortized impact, not hide it.
Saanvi Mehta: Agreed. Hiding cost during rollouts creates ticket storms. Suggestion: introduce an "amortization window" field and emit amortized_unit_cost per event. That way dashboards can compute a smoothed cost instead of dropping to zero.
Omar Hussein: Implementation detail: econ_event v2 add fields: route_variant, amortization_window_seconds, amortized_unit_cost, credit_reason, sample_count, sampling_rate. Consumers can choose gross vs amortized vs net.
Felix Hart: For backward compat, keep unit_cost but document ordering: effective_cost = COALESCE(amortized_unit_cost, effective_unit_cost, unit_cost).
Grace Lin: UX: default to "net (amortized)" in heatmap, but provide a toggle to view "gross" and "credited breakdown". Hover should show: tokens, gross_cost, amortized_cost, credits_by_reason.
Saanvi Mehta: We should also expose "amortization_basis": either "per-prefetch", "per-session-warmup", or "global-slab" so product teams understand the math.
Omar Hussein: SQL sketch (will adapt for ClickHouse): SELECT project, model_sku, route_variant, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(tokens * COALESCE(amortized_unit_cost, effective_unit_cost, unit_cost)) AS amortized_cost, SUM(tokens * unit_cost) AS gross_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN credit_reason IS NOT NULL THEN tokens * (unit_cost - COALESCE(amortized_unit_cost, effective_unit_cost)) ELSE 0 END) AS credited_savings, AVG(sampling_rate) AS sampling_rate, SUM(sample_count) AS sample_count FROM econ_events WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY project, model_sku, route_variant;
Felix Hart: Important: amortized_unit_cost is calculated by ingest when a prefetch is triggered and the amortization_window_seconds > 0. The formula we discussed: amortized_unit_cost = (warmup_cost + expected_prefetch_burn / expected_uses) / expected_tokens_per_invoke. We need to bake the fields used to compute it into the event for auditing.
Grace Lin: Auditability is key. Emit amortization_metadata fields like warmup_cost_usd, expected_uses, expected_tokens as part of the event. UI can show a compact breakdown.
Saanvi Mehta: Telemetry ask: retain raw econ_events for 45 days during rollout and flag reconciliations between old and new aggregates. We need to prove amortized totals reconcile to billed amounts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Retention override applied: econ-raw-events -> 45d for rollout namespaces. Canary job queued: cost-ingest-v2 -> canary-cluster.
Omar Hussein: Migration plan: proto bump -> ingest emits amortized fields -> consumer adapters use COALESCE -> dashboard opt-in flag "enable_amortized_costs" -> canary -> full rollout. Who takes which?
Felix Hart: I'll own the proto + ingest change. Will include migration notes and the amortization formula. ETA PR today.
Saanvi Mehta: I'll drive the UX: heatmap toggle + hover panel + the amortization mini-breakdown. Will add low-sample UX: if sample_count < 50 show "Estimate may be noisy" and display sample_count.
Grace Lin: I'll coordinate reconciliation with billing and open a dashboard test to compare net/amortized/gross over the last 7 days.
Omar Hussein: Ops: add feature flag `enable_amortized_costs` and schedule canary after Felix's PR merges. @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary window?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: cost-ingest-v2 -> canary-cluster at 2024-08-01T03:00Z (flag: enable_amortized_costs).
Felix Hart: Note: consumers should avoid joins to derive sampling_rate; ingest will write sampling_rate and sample_count at emit time. Also include amortization_basis enum for clarity.
Saanvi Mehta: UX copy for low-sample banner: "Amortized estimates: low sample (N). Values shown are extrapolated from sampled prefetch events and may be noisy"
Grace Lin: Action items: Felix -> proto PR + migration notes + amortization metadata; Saanvi -> mockups & copy + flag wiring; Omar -> ops flag + reconciliation job; Grace -> billing reconciliation dashboards.
Felix Hart: I'll post PR link here when ready.
Omar Hussein: One last ask: add a "why zeroed" trace link from the heatmap hover to the raw event examples so teams can inspect exact reason codes.
Saanvi Mehta: Good idea. We'll add a small link: "Inspect sample events" that opens the raw-event view filtered by route+variant.
Grace Lin: Thanks everyone. Let's avoid the next wave of "where did my cost go" tickets.
Omar Hussein: :thumbsup:
